description: Facebook 584 — 98 patches with Vietnamese UI, Following feed by default, save photos by default + hide tab bar on the Reels tab (on by default; hiding gives the bar's space back, a tap or swipe brings it back for three seconds; 0.17.8: giving the space back is re-asserted on every layout pass from the bar's own tree — the live pager is found from the bar and its bottom padding, and its pages', is taken again whenever Facebook settles it back — and the Reels page's own header hides too, on its own switch in Appearance, its height collapsed so reels get that space, back for three seconds on a touch) + experimental: push the video to the top when comments open (settings > Comments) + split the screen half and half when comments open, EXTENDED in 0.17.8 (the Hook diagnostics row proved the in-place controller path is never reached on the test phone — zero calls while real comments opened — so the half cap now also stands on the surfaces that phone can take: the regular comment sheet, its share capped where its parameters are built and its window height capped at both places the popover fragment settles it, the fixed eight-tenths box a full share falls back to included; and the video platform's split screen, its sheet height capped where it is handed to the sheet's component. The five split-screen launchers and the comment views setup only report that they ran, so the Hook diagnostics row — itself extended with the hunt's last-seen shares, ratio and heights — can say which surface a phone really opens comments through; on by default, settings > Comments) + tab bar background more transparent, about half of Facebook's own alpha (on by default, settings > Appearance) + the Hook diagnostics row (settings > Pause, backup and diagnostics); quiet preset.
